name: Refined Gated Linear Attention (ReGLA) – Production-Hardened.
description: Refined Gated Linear Attention (ReGLA) – Production-Hardened.  Combines element-wise key gating, normalized linear attention kernel evaluation, and short-range depthwise 1D convolutions without O(L) memory explosion. Supports: - Multi-architecture copy_weights (GPT-2, RoBERTa/BERT nested, Qwen/LLaMA, DistilBERT) - Trainable LoRA adapters with frozen base weights - GQA with repeat_kv - RoPE positio
